description: Verified per-token prices for an AI model across hosting providers, ranked cheapest first by blended cost (3:1 input to output). Each row has input, output and cached prices per 1M tokens in the provider's own currency, the source pricing page and the date it was verified. CC-BY-4.0. Each result includes an infrabase_url for attribution.

model.description: Model slug from list_models, e.g. gpt-oss-120b. The model name also works.
